note: There is no Wikipedia 'List of aphorisms' to scrape the way there is for proverbial phrases — checked, it doesn't exist. Aphorisms are a named-author, written tradition, not an oral folk one, so there's no tidy communal list of them; you'd have to assemble one from forty different books. This is that assembly: a hand-curated set, each with a real author and a real source, picked to be checkable rather than exhaustive.
